g.text: BIO
genes, germs,
injury, drugs
PSYCHO
beliefs, mood,
coping, trauma
SOCIAL
family, money,
culture, faith
THE PATIENT
ENGEL'S MODEL (exam core!): every illness = BIO × PSYCHO × SOCIAL interacting —
treat one circle and miss the person. Chest pain: BIO (MI?) × PSYCHO (terror of dying like
father!) × SOCIAL (breadwinner, can't afford admission!). Assess ALL three, always.
MIND-BODY PROOFS: stress → ulcers/HTN/flares · grief → immunity dips · fear → pain
amplified · hope + support → wounds heal faster. PLACEBO (belief heals!) vs NOCEBO (dread
harms!) — your words DOSE physiology: "this often helps within days" is medicine.
NURSE'S BPS ASSESSMENT: BIO — disease, pain, meds, function · PSYCHO — beliefs ("what do
you fear most…?"), mood, coping, trauma · SOCIAL — who decides? money? transport? faith?
work? Document all three (INF!) — plans touching one circle fail.
vs BIOMEDICAL: old model = body-as-machine, germ → drug. BPS keeps the drug AND adds the
person: counsel the fear, fund the transport, bless the faith — adherence follows.
EXAM MOVE: any "holistic care?" question = BPS three circles + one example EACH + "nurse
assesses all three" — full marks. Interview: "tell us holistic" = one patient's 3 circles.
MANTRA: "bio explains it, psycho feels it, social shapes it — nurse all three."
